- Agent: WebSurfer

  -- Observation: Found the official biography page on supremecourt.gov.
  -- Thought: Identified the page containing the official education details.
  -- Result: Provided the URL and the text "She received her B.A. and LL.B. from Stanford University."
- Agent: Planner
  -- Action: Synthesized information from all three sources (Britannica, Stanford Law School, Supreme Court).
  -- Observation: All sources consistently state she was educated at Stanford University (BA 1950, LLB/JD 1952).
  -- Thought: Concluded that the first woman appointed to the Supreme Court was educated at Stanford University in Stanford, California.
  -- Result: Formulated the final answer with citations from all three sources.
